prose:
This Hacker News discussion asks which older computing ideas deserve reconsideration now that hardware is faster and coding agents can reduce implementation effort. Early replies point to Pascal and the compact systems tradition associated with Oberon.

These suggestions identify areas for experimentation rather than demonstrating that revived tools outperform current systems. Participants’ preferences and historical comparisons are not benchmark results.
highlights: Question invites older ideas to be revisited
Hardware and coding effort motivate the topic
